Effect A scene: SoftDust + FineGrit CPUParticles3D
foot contacts from walked distance; one new instance per contact
procedural moth texture (generated, committed)
procedural moth texture (generated, committed)
procedural moth texture (generated, committed)
Effect B scene: 3 GPUParticles3D + 3 attractors
state -> emitting / restart / hide; reads, never writes
fixture preview over the real level (fixed seed on the preview only)
fixture preview over the real level (fixed seed on the preview only)
fixture preview over the real level (seeds 101/202/303)
fixture preview over the real level (seeds 101/202/303)
the night slice: FootstepScuffs, StringLightMoths, EffectsDebugKeys nodes
editor conversion of the moth ParticleProcessMaterial (Shriram)
headless CPU price with control
Effect A configuration read-back
Effect A state test, real keys
Effect B configuration read-back
Effect B state test, real keys
moth silhouette generator (r3: smoothstep)

components.explanation: Effect A, the sand scuff: footstep_scuff.tscn (SoftDust 10 + FineGrit 5 CPUParticles3D, one-shot, explosive, box emission, velocity/gravity/damping, scale curves, colour ramps, procedural GradientTexture2D quads, particle billboards); footstep_scuff_trigger.gd turns Hari's walked distance (_travel) into foot contacts every 0.84 m and instances a new scuff per contact (overlap, at most 4 alive), freed after 1.15 s; wired under FootstepScuffs in slice.tscn; fixture preview; tuning r1 (alpha ramp) and r2 (texture gradient).

Effect B, moths at the string lights: string_light_moths.tscn (3 GPUParticles3D sharing one ParticleProcessMaterial with turbulence and attractor interaction, preprocess 2.4 s, plus 3 GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D); the procedural moth texture (tools/moth_texture.gd, written to moth.tres / moth.png by tools/write_moth_texture.gd); string_light_moths_controller.gd drives emitting from LoopState.phase == NIGHT and clock_minutes < 1740, restarts on edges, hides after 2.4 s; fixture preview; tuning r1 (quad 3x), r2 (umber ramp), r3 (solid texture).

particles_generated.gdshader: Godot's conversion of MothsWest's ParticleProcessMaterial, made and saved by Shriram in the editor; unused by the game; two lines annotated by the film beside the brief settings.

Configuration read-back tests (A 128 checks, B 255), the state tests (A 19, B 63) and the headless CPU cost script with an empty-scene control; the debug keys F10/F11 used for Shriram's vsync-off FPS comparison.
